title: #snatchadams #taintymccracken #snatchadamsandtaintymccracken #itsthat...
transcript: Last night, my friends Kate and Marie and I attended Snatch Adams and Tainty McCracken Present: It’s That Time of The Month a mouthful of a title and a truly crazy show. Part scripted, part improv, part standup, it's basically a vagina and a taint hosting a talk show with a bunch of different segments. there's audience interaction, news updates, an interview with a special guest, commercials — it's a very wacky multimodal piece. And it's funny and educational, in terms of sex ed and the state of reproductive rights in this post-Roe era. I think this piece really comes together at the end where you're left with a nice sense of how and why this piece was conceived (no pun intended) and although the show contains a lot of satire and chaos, it ends with a message of hope, something which a lot of people need now more than ever. With that, another program for my collection.
